doc.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Recording with B. B. King
summary: Young says B. B. King called him in to record two or three times.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Yeah, so anyway how about, I‘m thinking of somebody else. How about B. B. King, you recorded with B. B. King.
Yeah, I made some recordings with B. B. King. He would call me in to, I wasn‘t with his group or anything, but he would call me in to record with him. And I did that
two or three times, I don‘t know how many times I did, but I did it more than once. B. B. King, I recorded with him.
